content:
Olivia S.: Heads up — ticket #3421 from Acme. Virtual corp card gets declined at checkout. Customer sees acquirer message: "MCC not allowed" and 3DS flow failed. They need this resolved asap for a renewal.

Olivia S.: Repro CURL we ran:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/payments/charge \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' \n  -d '{"amount": 12900, "currency":"usd", "card_token":"tok_vcorp_****", "merchant_id":"m_98765"}'
```

Response:
```
{ "status": "declined", "reason": "MCC_RESTRICTED", "acquirer_code": "345", "acquirer_message": "MCC not allowed for merchant 5411", "3ds": {"status":"failed","reason":"challenge_timeout"} }
```

Jason (Acme): Bank confirmed on their side: decline code maps to "merchant category restriction" and said the merchant is classified under "Software Services". They also reported a 3DS challenge timed out.

Jules (Payments): Can you paste the raw acquirer headers and BIN (first6) + last4? Also does this customer have company-level MCC allow/deny rules enabled?

Olivia S.: Pasted details below:

```
ACQUIRER-RESP: 345
ACQ-TRANS-ID: 0a9c-ff33
CARD-BIN: 411111\nCARD-LAST4: 4242\nAMOUNT: 129.00
CURRENCY: USD
MERCHANT-MCC: 5411
3DS-PROVIDER-LOG: challenge_timeout after 30s
```

Olivia S.: Customer says their admin controls block certain MCCs at company level, but they swear they did not block 5411.

Ava (Billing): Quick check — Acme has spend-control policies active. Policy table shows a per-card MCC block list: 5411 is *not* explicitly blocked, but there is a geo + high-risk online services rule that may trigger for this merchant id. Need their admin console screenshot of the policy and the attempted charge row.

Jules (Payments): Acquirer code 345 looks like issuer-side enforcement tied to either cardholder MCC restrictions or merchant acquiring mapping. Two parallel tracks: 1) get Acme to contact their issuing bank to ask for an exception (slow), or 2) apply a temporary MCC override on our side (fast, but requires finance sign-off and PO/attestation). 3DS failing is separate — if challenge times out we can attempt a non-3DS fallback if the acquirer allows. What does the payment provider support for fallback?

Olivia S.: I checked provider: they support an authenticated fallback (no challenge) if issuer allows, but it increases fraud score and may be rejected.

Ava (Billing): I can approve a temporary override while they sort with the bank. Need: attached PO or signed letter of attestation from Acme and expected monthly volume. Propose cap $50k/month. Please create an internal override request with that info.

Olivia S.: On it. Jason — can you upload the PO and confirmation that this is a scheduled renewal?

Jason (Acme): PO attached: PO-8792. Renewal is scheduled for 2026-04-03. Bank sent us the screenshot of the decline; attaching in the ticket.

payments-bot: Created override request PAY-558 for account acme_corp (owner: Ava). Status: pending-approval.

Jules (Payments): Once override is applied, we should attempt one small reauth (under $10) as a canary, and monitor for issuer chargebacks. Also ask Acme to retry checkout and confirm 3DS challenge behavior.

Olivia S.: Will coordinate with Acme, attach PO into the ticket, and request they retry. I'll update thread when override is approved/applied.

Ava (Billing): Approving temporary MCC override (5411) for account acme_corp up to $50k/month pending signed PO. Approval note saved to PAY-558.

Jason (Acme): Thanks team — sending confirmation to the bank to re-run 3DS. Will report back in ~30 mins.

Olivia S.: Great. Leaving this open until we see a successful reauth or need to revert the override.

Jules (Payments): FYI — if we see repeated 3DS timeouts from same 3DS provider, we should consider routing to alternate 3DS provider via our smart routing. Filing follow-up infra ticket if that happens.
